description: A list of rows of fields the person can add to, remove from and reorder: order lines, travellers, contacts. Rows are keyed, not numbered, so old input, validation errors and focus stay with the right row after every change. Any field works in a row, select and date pickers included. Keyboard reorderable, announced to screen readers, with a minimum and maximum number of rows.

consider.note: A request can send any keys and any number of rows. Cap them with `max:` on the array, and look each existing key up through the record it belongs to (`$order->lines()->findOrFail($key)`), never as a bare id, or anyone could edit anyone's rows.

Every row is in the page and in the request, so keep lists to what a person edits by hand: a few dozen rows, a hundred or so at most, each with a few fields. Past that, or with a select or date picker in every row, page the records or edit them in a table instead. `max:` caps what the server takes either way, and PHP's `max_input_vars` (1000 by default) quietly drops fields past it: 200 rows of 5 fields already reach it.

x-widget.repeater.empty: Shown while there are no rows: what the list is for, so the add button makes sense on its own.
